scenes.head: ICAR Technical Assistant भर्ती 2026

scenes.text: सरकारी नौकरी की बड़ी खबर — Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board, यानी ASRB ने ICAR के लिए Technical Assistant और Senior Technical Assistant के कुल एक हज़ार तीन सौ तिरानवे पदों पर भर्ती निकाली है। Technical Assistant के एक हज़ार दो सौ चौवन पद हैं और Senior Technical Assistant के एक सौ उनतालीस पद। इस Short में योग्यता, फीस और आखिरी तारीख — सब कुछ।

scenes.head: योग्यता क्या चाहिए?

scenes.text: योग्यता — अपने Functional Group से संबंधित विषय में Bachelor's Degree चाहिए, जैसे Agriculture, Library Science या Computer Science। Workshop वाले पदों के लिए B.E., B.Tech या तीन साल का Diploma चलेगा। आपकी Degree सत्रह दिसंबर दो हज़ार छब्बीस तक पूरी हो जानी चाहिए।

yt_desc:
ICAR Technical Assistant (T-3) & Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) Recruitment 2026 — 1,393 posts!

Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board (ASRB) has announced the Centralised Combined Examination 2026 (Notification F. No. 2(2)/2025-Exam, dated 11 November 2026) for direct recruitment:
• Technical Assistant (T-3) — 1,254 posts (ICAR Institutes)
• Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) — 139 posts (KVKs of ICAR)
• Total: 1,393 posts

Eligibility: Bachelor's degree in the relevant subject for your Functional Group (Agriculture / Horticulture / Agri Engineering / Biotechnology / Food Science / Home Science / B.V.Sc. & A.H. / B.F.Sc. / Library Science / BCA / Computer Science / IT etc.), or B.E./B.Tech / 3-year Diploma for workshop posts. Age: 21–30 years as on 17.12.2026.

Last date to apply online: 17 December 2026 (11:59 PM)
Fee (one post): UR ₹300 | EWS/OBC ₹150 | SC/ST/PwBD/Women — FREE
Selection: Preliminary CBT (qualifying) + Mains CBT — NO interview.

Apply online only at the official website: https://asrb.gov.in

Watch the full-detail video on this channel for group-wise vacancies, exam pattern and step-by-step apply process.
